import csv
seen=set()
with open('people.csv',newline='') as f, open('out.csv','w',newline='') as g:
    r=csv.reader(f); w=csv.writer(g,lineterminator='\n')
    header=next(r); w.writerow(header)

        if key and key in seen: continue
        if key: seen.add(key)
        w.writerow(row)
EOF
